notes.title: Games Made in NZ
notes.content:
Hello friends,

Hope you are all doing well. This is our first update and certainly not the last as we have some awesome news to share in the upcoming months!

Just wanted to let you know about the upcoming sales event on Steam so you can all take advantage of great discounts and upcoming games! :) 

From Monday onwards the 28th of September a new Steam Sale event starts called "Games Made In NZ", which will feature a bunch of amazing games made by New Zealand developers, such as Ashen, Icarus, Mini Motorway, Poly Bridge, Flintlock and many others, including our own Criminals Within :)

The event runs for a week so plenty of time to get the best stuff possible. Let us know which games made by NZ developers you are most looking forward to play!

Cheers,
Zsombi - Space Rock Games
